Azivor Reference

Add Azivor to ChatGPT.

Find curated visual references in your conversation, with the actual images, design notes, and original sources.

Use ChatGPT on the web. Your account or workspace must allow custom MCP connections. Azivor Reference is free and does not ask for an API key or payment details.

  1. Open the plugin setup

    Sign in to ChatGPT, open Plugins, then choose Add (or +) → Add custom MCP server.

    Open ChatGPT plugins

    Keep this guide open while you fill in the connection.

  2. Enter these connection details

    Use the public server URL below. If you see a choice between a URL and a tunnel, choose the URL.

    Authentication

    No authentication

    Review ChatGPT’s connection warning. If you choose to proceed, tick I understand and want to continue and select Create as a plugin.

    The description field is optional. The connection can search the public gallery; it cannot edit the collection or your files.

  3. Install it and ask for references

    Open the new Azivor Reference plugin in your Personal plugins. Select Install or the + button if shown.

    Start a new Work chat. Type @, select Azivor Reference, then send:

    A successful search returns reference images with design notes and original-source links.

If you get stuck

I don’t see “Add custom MCP server”

Custom connections depend on your ChatGPT plan, account, and workspace permissions. In a managed workspace, ask your administrator whether Create plugins with MCPs is allowed. This guide cannot enable an unavailable account feature.

Check OpenAI’s connection requirements

The connection fails or images are missing

Check that the server address ends in /mcp and authentication is set to No authentication. Start a new Work chat and select Azivor Reference with @ before sending your prompt.

If images still don’t appear, contact azivorai@gmail.com with the prompt and your ChatGPT client. You can also browse the gallery directly.

I already added Azivor Reference

Open your existing plugin under Personal or Installed and use it from a new chat. You do not need to create another connection.

Instructions follow OpenAI’s manual setup guide. Button labels may vary by account.
